$comment: Every string field of every client request, client notification and answer to a server request that is not a free-text field (src/free_text.rs FREE_TEXT): a lone surrogate there refuses the frame. `*` is any one segment. `payloads` enumerates, for each value the schema leaves untyped, the string fields the code that reads it reads (`fields`, or the `schema` definition it deserialises into), with that code as `source`; `open` is JSON with no fixed fields a model or a tool's source wrote (free text below: FREE_TEXT has `path/**`); `opaque` is JSON with no fixed fields and no typed text, refused whole (`path/**` here), with its reason. `reasons` says, for every refused field whose name reads like text, why it cannot hold text a person typed. The contract test (tests/it/contract.rs every_string_field_is_free_text_or_named_as_refused) fails on a field in neither list, an untyped value with no declaration, and a text-like refused field without a reason.

/args.source: native/core/crates/mixdog-services/src/channels/call.rs dispatch, tools.rs dispatch, setup.rs run, admin.rs save_schedule_row/save_webhook_row, ports.rs WebhookPatch::from_params

/draft/route/fallbacks/*.source: native/core/crates/mixdog-core-session/src/session/new_route.rs draft_pick (copies provider, model, effort; never reads fallbacks)

/args.source: native/core/crates/mixdog-tools/src/orch/agent dispatch.rs run, scope.rs Scope::of, flow/send.rs, flow/spawn.rs, resume.rs, model_select.rs

/input.source: native/core/crates/mixdog-core-config/src/workflow/thread_settings.rs switch_context (desktopSession goes on unread: thread_switches.rs switch_context ignores it)

/payload.source: native/core/crates/mixdog-core-agents/src/agents/edit.rs plan_save, save_files, apply_manifest_edits; avatar.rs avatar_update; mod.rs (route)

/value.opaque: a setting value at any path, of any shape: the relay-writable paths (RELAY_SETTING_PATHS, service.rs) hold booleans and enums, the others ids and scopes; no setting the clients write is typed text

opaque./params: the language-server request params, sent to the server process as they came (positions, URIs, symbol queries): a lone surrogate in them never reaches a language server Node wrote it to as an escape, so the request is refused

/owner.source: no core handler reads it (the method has no service outside mixdog-app-protocol)

/options.source: no core handler reads it (the method has no service outside mixdog-app-protocol)

/resumeFrom.source: no core handler reads it (the method has no service outside mixdog-app-protocol)

/input.source: native/core/crates/mixdog-core-domains/src/domains/remote_access.rs register_push (a Web Push subscription, stored as given)
native/core/crates/mixdog-app-server-daemon/src/live_view.rs BrowserPage::dispatch (forwards it); the host reads it: apps/desktop/src/main/browser/page-surface-control.ts createPageInputDispatcher

/value.source: native/core/crates/mixdog-core-domains/src/domains/host.rs state_set (HostStateSetParams: browserTabs, browserImport, displayPreferences are the desktop's own JSON, published as given)
/value.opaque: the desktop's own state for keys other than visualize (browser tabs, import progress, display preferences), published to clients as given; it carries tab and page ids and URLs the core and the clients match, and no text a person typed

/request.source: native/core/crates/mixdog-app-server-daemon/src/live_view_streams.rs normalize_stream_options (numbers, fit: an object of numbers)

/call/request/messages/*/assistantBlocks.open: a model's earlier content blocks (text, thinking), forwarded to the provider and never compared

/call/request/messages/*/content/*/sourc.open: a document's content, forwarded to the provider

/call/request/messages/*/providerReplay/.source: native/core/crates/mixdog-ai/src/providers/anthropic/lowering.rs (forwarded; the owner compared is providerReplay/*/owner, outside the items)
/call/request/messages/*/providerReplay/.open: a model's reasoning items, forwarded to the provider

/call/request/messages/*/thinkingBlocks.open: a model's thinking text, forwarded to the provider

/call/request/messages/*/toolCalls/*/arg.open: tool-call arguments a model wrote, forwarded to the provider

/call/request/options/providerState.opaque: provider-owned continuation state (cache names, response ids, account ids) that the providers compare with their own; it never holds typed text

/call/request/tools/*/inputSchema.open: a tool's JSON schema (descriptions written in a tool's source), forwarded to the provider

/state.opaque: the desktop updater's state (status, versions, download progress), published to clients as given; no text a person typed

/event/usage/raw.opaque: a provider's raw usage object (counts and provider keys), kept as given

/event/value.source: native/core/crates/mixdog-core-domains/src/domains/ai_admin/model_proxy.rs event_in (citations, server tool blocks, thinking blocks)
/event/value.open: text a model or a web page wrote (citations, thinking)

host/screen/displays.opaque: the desktop's display list (ids, geometry, the OS's monitor names), relayed to the asking phone as given; no text a person typed

host/update/command.source: native/core/crates/mixdog-core-domains/src/domains/update.rs update/desktop/command (the answer is the caller's reply)
host/update/command.opaque: the desktop updater's state, answered to the asking client as given; no text a person typed

/result/failure/partialUsage/raw.opaque: a provider's raw usage object, kept as given

/result/models/*/raw.opaque: a provider's raw model record, kept as given

reasons.reason: a record's key, not a label: the core finds the record by it or checks it is unique by it (a schedule, webhook, MCP server, plugin, built-in tool or feature, skill, environment variable), as Node did by the same string; the label a person reads is a separate field where one exists
a tool, model, provider or parameter id that the core matches against its catalog or tool list; the text a person reads beside it (displayName, description, label) is listed as free text

a file's name: compared with a folder's entries before a file is made or opened, or the name of a file the client read from disk; a name holding a lone unit names no file Node would have found (decisions.md "frame-lone-surrogate")
a git ref, commit, tag or config key, or a worktree name that becomes a branch and folder name: matched against the repository; git and Node's ref checks refuse a ref that is not well-formed text
a duration, parsed into a number of milliseconds; text holding a lone unit is no duration and Node refused it in the same parser
an executable path run as a process: a path, not text
a sign-in address or a secret sent to a service as it is: compared by that service, never shown as text
the client app's own name, a constant of the shipped client
host-only (an agent queue entry's context): a connection's request carrying it is invalidParams before any check of its text
an image's bytes (base64) and the metadata line the resize wrote from it, not typed text
an effort level or output style id from a fixed list
a close reason code the phone's WebRTC stack writes
compared with the file's content on disk (the stale-content check): a lone unit there equalled nothing in Node; read as U+FFFD it would equal a real U+FFFD, so it is refused
a selector of files (glob or path), compared with file names
a phone's machine-written account of a reconnect (phase, state and issue tokens); the core keeps only [A-Za-z0-9_=@:. -] of it for its log
